english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a tall person, animal, tree, building, or other object.

examples.english: My son is tall for his age.
examples.traditional: 我個仔以佢呢個年紀嚟講算高。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 ji5 keoi5 ni1 go3 nin4 gei2 lei4 gong2 syun3 gou1

english.note: Use 高 when describing a salary as high or generous in everyday speech, as in 份人工好高.

examples.english: This job offers a really handsome salary.
examples.traditional: 呢份工嘅人工真係好高。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 jan4 gung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 gou1
